interpretation.targetHorizon: T+1: first unseen live tick after the forecast is frozen
interpretation.sameAsCurrent: AI prediction for T+1 equals source/current digit T
interpretation.naturalRepeat: actual T+1 equals source/current digit T
interpretation.hit: AI prediction frozen at T equals actual unseen T+1
interpretation.canonicalScoring: Only the next unique canonical Deriv tick may score a forecast; exact duplicate deliveries are rejected.
interpretation.caution: AI score is an internal model score, not a calibrated probability.
